scope: Weighted mixed-interaction budgets are preserved at every finite depth of exact singleton Gibbs elimination. Actual random-site conditional covariance, weighted oscillation iteration, stationarity and a geometric telescoping limit prove a Gibbs covariance bound with no number-of-sites or color-count factor. A constructed least periodic coordinate radius supplies the Wilson geometry. For actual SU(2) Wilson input, the initial exponential row budget is at most 36*beta*exp(m); when this is <1 and beta,m>=0, every finite induced stage law satisfies |Cov(F,G)| <= |S|*norm(F)*norm(G)*exp(-m*R)/(1-36*beta*exp(m)) for observables supported on S,T separated by periodic radius R. No generated-support coloring or stagewise smallness premise is used. Weak-coupling entry, the physical-scale coarse representation, a nonzero continuum limit and the physical mass gap remain unproved.

weighted_elimination.assumptions: c>=0, zero diagonal, w>=0, w(i,j)<=w(i,e)*w(e,j), initial weighted rows<=alpha<=1
weighted_elimination.calculation: w*step(c) <= step(w*c); the existing removed-column row accounting preserves alpha at every finite depth.
weighted_elimination.spatial_weights: w(i,j)=exp(m*d(i,j)) for m>=0 and a distance satisfying the triangle inequality.

actual_covariance.one_step: Actual singleton conditional covariance is at most delta_i(F)*delta_i(G)/4, proved with the compact Gibbs covariance theorem. The random-site average divides its sum by N.
actual_covariance.iteration: Weighted oscillations contract at q_N=1-(1-alpha)/N. Stationarity gives a vanishing covariance remainder, and geometric telescoping cancels the site count N.
actual_covariance.bound: If sum_j C(i,j)u(j)<=alpha*u(i) and delta_i(G)<=b*u(i), then |Cov(F,G)|<=b*sum_i u(i)*delta_i(F)/(4*(1-alpha)); an ordinary row bound<=alpha supplies convergence.
actual_covariance.localization: For u(i)=exp(-m*r(i)), with r a distance-to-support potential vanishing on T and at least R on S, the bound is |S|*norm(F)*norm(G)*exp(-m*R)/(1-alpha).

wilson_specialization.geometry: The least natural radius in PeriodicSupportRelation.Close is constructed; symmetry, triangle inequality, actual plaquette diameter<=1 and distance to a nonempty support are proved. Periodic wrapping is retained.
wilson_specialization.initial_budget: The actual Wilson seed vanishes at periodic distance>1, so its exponential row budget is <=36*beta*exp(m).
wilson_specialization.all_stages: For beta,m>=0 and 36*beta*exp(m)<1, the covariance estimate holds for every finite singleton-elimination schedule and its constructed Wilson stageLaw.
wilson_specialization.eliminated_variables: The stage action is represented on the full product with inactive integrated variables. Retained-coordinate observables see the genuine retained marginal. Uniform bounds on eliminated-source responses are not asserted.

remaining: Establish a small exponentially weighted coarse mixed budget uniformly along an independently justified weak-coupling trajectory beta(a)->infinity; the present theorem only preserves initial smallness.
Relate the exact elimination tower to a gauge-covariant coarse representation at a fixed physical scale, including large fields, boundary conditions, source responses and renormalization.
Control the weights and localized source norms on the surviving observables uniformly at that physical scale; the result does not identify random-site update time with physical transfer time.
Prove the original transfer fixed-physical-slab contraction and compatible all-order continuum bounds, together with a nonzero finite-energy excitation on the same trajectory.
All twelve full Clay obligations remain open.
